content.rendered: Remote open/close with position feedback. The actuator has a manual override for when the power is off.

excerpt.rendered: Full-bore stainless ball valve with a 24 V electric actuator.

acf.specs:

Pressure rating: PN40
Actuator: 24 V DC, 15 s
Body: stainless steel 316
Seats: PTFE
